description: This file contains utility functions for calculating spatial relationships between DOM elements, such as 'left-of', 'right-of', 'above', 'below', and 'near', used for layout selection logic.

methods.name: boxRightOf
methods.description: Calculates the distance of box1 to the right of box2 within an optional maximum distance.

methods.name: boxLeftOf
methods.description: Calculates the distance of box1 to the left of box2 within an optional maximum distance.

methods.name: boxAbove
methods.description: Calculates the distance of box1 above box2 within an optional maximum distance.

methods.name: boxBelow
methods.description: Calculates the distance of box1 below box2 within an optional maximum distance.

methods.name: boxNear
methods.description: Calculates the proximity score between box1 and box2, returning undefined if beyond threshold.

methods.name: layoutSelectorScore
methods.description: Computes the best score for a layout relation ('left-of', 'right-of', etc.) between an element and a set of inner elements.
